item.title: VXLAN Between a FortiGate and Proxmox, Part 3: Automating It With Terraform
item.description: Taking the hand-built FortiGate and Proxmox EVPN fabric and reproducing it entirely in code, one Terraform workspace driving both platforms, with every wall I hit along the way written down so you do not have to hit them too.
